project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA - calendar spread trading dashboard
verification_instructions: Run `npx tsc -b` to type-check, then `npx vite build` to confirm production bundle builds without errors
environment_constraints: Internet available for npm installs. No test suite exists, so verification is type-check + build only.
contribution_requirements: DO NOT touch any logic (api.ts, format.ts, any state/hooks/data-flow in components). Only restyle/redesign the UI.
key_patterns: Single styles.css file with CSS custom properties (--bg, --text, --accent, etc). Components use className strings referencing those CSS classes. Fonts loaded via Google Fonts in index.html (Inter + JetBrains Mono). No CSS modules, no Tailwind, no UI library.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, index.html, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json. src/: App.tsx (main app with routing), StockCard.tsx (card per stock), StockDetail.tsx (detail view with charts), LineChart.tsx (SVG chart), TradesPanel.tsx (modal with trades), SkeletonCard.tsx (loading placeholder), Admin.tsx (login page), api.ts (API calls - DO NOT TOUCH), format.ts (formatters - DO NOT TOUCH), styles.css (all styling), main.tsx (entry point).
